question: Why can guest not load Bookings (401) in UntisX (endpoint /bookings)?
answer: Check role guest. Module Bookings may require higher permissions. Error 401: on 401/403 check credentials and tab permissions, on 404 check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt, on 500 check server logs and database, on timeout check the Docker container and network. Validate endpoint /bookings and the database connection. Feature Push must be enabled.
